task: EPMCDME-15512: agent dispatch bars in the CLI analytics session Timeline start at the Agent tool call start (agent.tool.start; the launch ack only as a fallback) and run until SubagentStop, clamped to session end; implemented in reader SQL, handler, response model, and tests.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: CLI analytics PostgreSQL reader (session dispatch query), CLI analytics handler (dispatch assembly and clamping), Local Analytics response model (LocalAnalyticsDispatchRow), CLI analytics reader and handler test suites

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: None material in code. Edge cases (no launch, launch before session start, stop after session end, missing stop) are explicitly handled in code and documented in docstrings.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: New CTE chain matching the Agent tool call to SubagentStop by agentId, tool_response parsing via regex for agentId, choice of the run-time anchor (the launch ack lags the call start by 1.9-8.3 s), timestamp arithmetic in SQL and Python, null semantics for unfinished subagents, clamping logic; changes the duration meaning of the public dispatch row (duration_ms null when stop never arrived)
technical_risk.mitigation: Live dispatch test added (test_reader_live_dispatches.py) covering the subagent stop join and naive UTC start comparison; handler unit tests cover clamp and null paths; response model contract kept field-compatible with the UI

key_reasoning.reason: Touches the cli_analytics reader SQL, the Local Analytics handler, and the LocalAnalyticsDispatchRow response model across Repository, Service and API-model layers; all within one subsystem

Introduces a new call-start-to-SubagentStop join keyed on agentId parsed from the Agent tool response, plus null and clamping semantics for unfinished or late subagents; no exact precedent for this join in the file
